title: Blue longspan hip roof on a bungalow
summary: Blue longspan hip roof on a bungalow. The neighbour liked the work and called us to roof his house too.
story: A bungalow with several roof sections joined together, finished in blue longspan with ridge caps on every hip and matching fascia round the whole building. The owner of the house next door saw the finished roof and invited us to do his own roof in beige longspan, which we also completed.

photos.alt: Blue longspan hip roof on a bungalow with an arched porch
Side view of the blue longspan roof and fascia on a bungalow

title: Black stone coated roof with roof vents
summary: Black stone coated tiles on a large bungalow, with small vented gables on the hips and white fascia.
story: A large bungalow with many roof sections, covered in black stone coated tiles. Small vented gables sit on the hips to let hot air out of the roof, and white fascia runs round the edge.

photos.alt: Large bungalow with a black stone coated roof, small vented gables and white fascia

title: Two-storey building: wood work and gold longspan roof
summary: Hip roof on a large two-storey building, with the wood work and gold longspan sheets.
story: A big two-storey block with a hip roof. Our team set up the roof frame, then fixed gold longspan sheets with ridge cap and fascia all round. The photos show the work in progress from outside and from inside the building.

photos.alt: Two-storey block building with a gold longspan hip roof, evening
Gold longspan roof on a two-storey building, with roof frame visible on the next section
Roofers on top of a two-storey building fixing gold longspan sheets
Two roofers working on the gold longspan roof of a two-storey building
Gold longspan roof with trusses ready for the next section
Roofers fixing gold longspan sheets near the roof frame
View from inside the building up to the sheets and roof frame
Inside view of the roof frame and longspan sheets during installation

title: Shingle-style stone coated roof with gutters
summary: Grey shingle-pattern stone coated tiles, finished with white gutters along the roof edge.
story: A bungalow roofed with shingle-pattern stone coated tiles in black and grey, with a separate roof over the porch and white rain gutters fitted along the edges.

photos.alt: Shingle-style stone coated roof with white gutters on a bungalow

title: Hip roof on a bungalow, longspan with roof vent
summary: Beige longspan hip roof with a vent at the top, fascia and finishing.
story: A bungalow roofed with beige longspan in a hip shape, finished with ridge caps, fascia and a small vent at the top of the roof.

photos.alt: Finished beige longspan hip roof on a bungalow
Close view of the beige longspan hip roof and fascia
Roofers fixing the last longspan sheets on a hip roof
Roofer on a bungalow fixing beige longspan sheets

title: Black stone coated hip roof
summary: Black stone coated tiles on a hip roof, with our roofer finishing the top.
story: A bungalow roofed with black stone coated tiles in a hip shape, with a lower roof section joined at the side. The photos show the finished roof and our roofer completing the last tiles.

photos.alt: Black stone coated hip roof on a bungalow
Roofer finishing a black stone coated hip roof

title: Stone coated roof on a bungalow
summary: Black stone coated (Gerard type) tiles on a bungalow with a hip roof.
story: A bungalow finished with black stone coated tiles, including the ridge and the small roof sections over the front.

photos.alt: Bungalow with a black stone coated tile roof

title: Brown longspan roof on a bungalow
summary: Brown longspan roof with a gable over the arched front, being finished by our team.
story: A bungalow roofed with brown longspan, with a small gable section over the arched front and fascia round the roof. The photo shows our team finishing the top of the roof.

photos.alt: Roofers finishing a brown longspan roof on a bungalow

title: Brown stone coated roof on a bungalow
summary: Brown stone coated tiles on a bungalow, with a separate roof over the porch.
story: A bungalow roofed with brown stone coated tiles, with its own small hip roof over the front porch and fascia round the edges.

photos.alt: Bungalow with a brown stone coated tile roof and porch roof

title: Rain gutters and downpipes
summary: White gutters and downpipes following the shape of the roof edge.
story: Rain gutters fitted along the roof edge and around the corners, with a downpipe taking the water down the wall.

photos.alt: White rain gutter and downpipe on a plastered house

title: Roof frame on a bungalow
summary: Wood work for a long bungalow roof, ready for the sheets.
story: The full roof frame on a long bungalow: trusses, rafters and purlins in place, ready for the roofing sheets.

photos.alt: Roofers on the wooden roof frame of a long bungalow
Wooden roof frame against the evening sky

title: Hip roof wood work with wall flashing
summary: Hip roof frame with wall flashing on the parapet.
story: Wood work for a hip roof: trusses, hip rafters and purlins, with flashing already fitted on the top of the wall.

photos.alt: Hip roof wooden frame with flashing on the wall
Inside the wooden roof frame, looking along the trusses
